limitations: No physical actuators, camera capture, hostile Python plugin sandbox or multi-tenant service boundary.
Local database is plaintext; backups and separately retained hashes are owner responsibility.
Checkpoint/history scans have not been load-tested for large stores; no indefinite retention guarantee.
Synapse OS has a separately verified user-space Beast installer; formal HEARTLIGHT integration remains future work; world-store and bio/IBM paths remain separate experimental surfaces.
Configured provider labels in normal operation do not attest model weights; historical frozen experiment receipts are separate.
The real Ollama story demo establishes measured context delivery and narrow fact emission, not perfect recall, personality preservation or general conversational quality.
Hosted runners do not establish physical USB/filesystem behavior or arbitrary cross-device certification.
Mobile builds use reference fixtures; no bundled mobile LLM engine or real-model physical-device acceptance.
Apple distribution signing, physical device acceptance and live IBM/Azure account verification remain external gates.
release_policy: release.yml requires exact-source Product CI, security, native/platform builds, real story delivery and Linux-to-Windows portable-state acceptance; final results live in released receipts.
